entities.name: Jacques Gouin de Beauchêne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jacques Gouin de Beauchêne was a French explorer and leader of the first French trading expedition to the Pacific. His name is also spelled as Beauchesne. He was born in Saint-Malo in Brittany, and died there at 78 years of age.
